test_cases.name: happy_path_task_dispatch_and_execution
test_cases.description: Full lifecycle execution where gateway enqueues a message to worker, which dequeues, validates, executes handler, and updates state.
test_cases.input: Initialize actor://ingest/gateway and actor://transform/normalizer. Enqueue NORMALIZE_PAYLOAD envelope to normalizer mailbox.

test_cases.name: shared_state_violation_rejection
test_cases.description: Attempt to directly access or mutate an external actor private state is intercepted by invariant check, emitting SHARED_STATE_VIOLATION.
test_cases.input: Actor rogue attempts direct memory write mutation into target actor private state container.

test_cases.name: malformed_message_payload_quarantine
test_cases.description: Message arriving with payload violating declared schema fails Step 3d validation and is diverted to DLQ with MALFORMED_MESSAGE_PAYLOAD.
test_cases.input: Dispatch CALCULATE_METRIC to actor://metrics/calculator with payload violating schema constraints.

test_cases.name: message_ttl_expiration_drop
test_cases.description: Message whose elapsed queue time exceeds configured ttl_ms is dropped at Step 3c with MESSAGE_TTL_EXPIRED.
test_cases.input: Enqueue message with ttl_ms 1000 to mailbox, dequeue after 2500ms elapsed.

test_cases.name: mailbox_overflow_backpressure_rejection
test_cases.description: Enqueuing message into a mailbox that has reached max_queue_depth triggers backpressure and emits MAILBOX_OVERFLOW.
test_cases.input: Attempt to enqueue message into mailbox whose current depth equals max_queue_depth 1000.

test_cases.name: poison_pill_runtime_fault_isolation
test_cases.description: Message triggering an uncaught exception during handler execution is quarantined to DLQ as a poison pill without crashing the actor loop.
test_cases.input: Process message whose handler encounters an unhandled runtime zero-division exception.

test_cases.name: unknown_message_type_quarantine
test_cases.description: Message with an unrecognized message_type is rejected during schema validation and diverted to DLQ with UNKNOWN_MESSAGE_TYPE.
test_cases.input: Dispatch message with message_type UNREGISTERED_CUSTOM_TYPE to worker actor.
